params.body:
## What

The pipeline reads the Gentells Standard (`Trendwolves/gentells-standard`, tag `v0.1.1`). The vocabulary and every threshold it judges by come from a pinned copy, `packages/core/standard.mjs`, instead of constants spread over twelve modules.

**Nothing the pipeline does changes.** That is the point of this step, and it is checked:

- `taxonomy.mjs` and `elements.mjs` export byte for byte what they exported before (a snapshot of every export, compared before and after).
- The constants keep their names (`LIFECYCLE`, `TWIN_LINE`, `ENRICH_GIVE_UP_AFTER`, ...), filled from the standard, so no caller changed.
- The weighting in `detectPatternCandidates` is generated from the standard's ladder, and the generated SQL is character for character what was written.

## How

- `bin/sync-standard.mjs [--ref vX.Y.Z]` fetches a tag of the standard and writes `packages/core/standard.mjs`: one plain ES module, because the Vite app imports `taxonomy.mjs` too and cannot read files. It is a generated copy rather than a dependency because the standard is private and neither the box nor CI can install from it.
- `packages/core/standard-rules.mjs` gives the rules to the modules, and executes the two signal ladders both in JS (`climb`) and as SQL (`ladderSql`).
- Wired: pattern status and detection weights, window, score and platform bonus; concept confirm and retire; match-before-mint stop words, stems and threshold (also in `concept-fold`); co-occurrence worth and decay; trend twins, births, cap, lapse and half-life; recurrence window and move; evidence kinds (both the JS map and the SQL `CASE` in the mix); convergence; the give-up count and promotion lines; pattern prune and recency; the element fingerprint cap.

## Tests

`test/standard.test.mjs`, 33 cases:

- **The copy is not hand-edited.** Its digest is recomputed and must match, and it must come from a tag, not a local checkout.
- **The exports are what they were.** 17 topics, 14 regions without the continents, the seven cohorts the pipeline still writes, 12 sectors each with a topic, 13 elements.
- **Conformance.** The standard's own cases run against the pipeline's own functions: `nameKey` and `findDuplicate`, `isTwin`, `directionOf` (now exported), `normaliseFingerprint`, `signalWorth`, and the generated detection SQL, run in SQLite.
- **The paper keeps up.** Nineteen `code:` facts in the ProveML paper must equal the standard, so a threshold cannot change under a paper that still verifies the old one.

Whole suite: 906 pass. `node --check packages/server/server.mjs` passes, and the Vite app builds. `gh` and `tar` are declared in `binaries.mjs` as optional, used only by the sync script.

## Not in this pull request

This is the first of three steps. Next is generation and lifestage as separate axes, with `lifestage_tags` and the data moved. After that, regions nested under their continents, with "Europe" no longer read as Benelux.
params.title: The pipeline reads the Gentells Standard
